name: Tiled 2D Texture Volume Representation
definition: A technique to store 3D volumetric data in a 2D texture by tiling the data laterally (x,y) and along the RGB color channels (representing the z-axis slices).
summary: Tiled 2D Texture Volume Representation stores 3D data in 2D textures by mapping depth to RGB channels, enabling 3D rendering on hardware lacking native 3D texture support.
